Paraboot is one of the greatest shoe brands in history and they haven't changed a dang thing! Today we are giving a little looksie to the Paraboot Michaels. A trendy (for 80 years) shoe that's built for architects, nurses, and even vets but now is worn by the likes of Taylor Swift (in a new Target ad). What on Earth did Paraboot do to satisfy this interesting group of professionals? What the heck is a Norwegian welt? What is a Goodyear welt? Today we will attempt to dive into all of these! 

*Shop around! You can find these for far less than $635.
